TypeWhisper Slack/Teams Meeting Notes Automation Setup

This guide recreates the current Mac setup on a fresh Mac: TypeWhisper + Groq + Meeting Notes workflow + FSNotes native note viewing + Hammerspoon auto-start/stop when Slack or Microsoft Teams call UI is detected. Long calls are still sent to TypeWhisper in 60-second segments, but FSNotes shows one final note per call with transcript, summary, and action items.

Last verified: 2026-05-14 17:32 IST
Current TypeWhisper: 1.3.3 (703)
Current CLI: /usr/local/bin/typewhisper
Automation: Hammerspoon + TypeWhisper local API on 127.0.0.1:8978

2. Install applications 3. macOS permissions 4. Groq integration 5. Recording settings 6. Meeting Notes workflow 7. FSNotes native note viewer 8. Hammerspoon automation 9. End-to-end verification 10. Troubleshooting

2. Install Applications

Install Homebrew first if the Mac does not already have it. Then install Hammerspoon and FSNotes. TypeWhisper may be installed manually from its release package if it is not available through Homebrew on the target Mac.

# Homebrew, if needed:
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

# Tools used by the automation:
brew install --cask hammerspoon
brew install --cask fsnotes

# Optional but useful:
brew install sqlite

# Verify:
ls -ld /Applications/Hammerspoon.app /Applications/FSNotes.app
ls -ld /Applications/TypeWhisper.app

Launch the apps once so macOS creates their containers and prompts for permissions:

open -a TypeWhisper
open -a Hammerspoon
open -a FSNotes

3. macOS Permissions

macOS permissions are the part most likely to require manual user approval. Codex or Claude Code can navigate to these panes, but the user may need to approve the final toggles.

TypeWhisper

  • Grant Microphone access.
  • Grant Screen & System Audio Recording access.
  • Add TypeWhisper under System Audio Recording Only. After adding it, macOS will ask to quit and reopen TypeWhisper. Choose Quit & Reopen.
open 'x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_ScreenCapture'

Hammerspoon

Grant Hammerspoon Accessibility permission. The watcher inspects Slack and Teams window titles/accessibility text, so it cannot detect calls without this permission.

open 'x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_Accessibility'

Codex or Claude Code

If an agent is doing the setup, it may also need Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions so it can operate app UI and take screenshots.

4. TypeWhisper Groq Integration

  1. Open TypeWhisper Settings.
  2. Go to Integrations.
  3. Install and enable Groq.
  4. Open Groq settings and paste the Groq API key. Do not put the key in scripts or this guide.
  5. Set Transcription Model to Whisper Large V3 Turbo.
  6. Set LLM Model to llama-3.3-70b-versatile.

Verify from Terminal after installing the command line tool and enabling the API server:

typewhisper status
typewhisper models
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8978/v1/status

5. TypeWhisper Recording Settings

Go to Recording and configure these values:

  • Default Engine: Groq
  • Model: Whisper Large V3 Turbo
  • Input Device: System Default
  • Preserve clipboard content: on
  • App-aware formatting: on
  • Reduce system volume during recording: off

Go to Recorder and configure:

  • Microphone: on
  • System Audio: on
  • Track Mode: Mixed
  • Live Transcription: on
  • Engine: Groq
  • Model: Whisper Large V3 Turbo
  • Spoken Language: Restrict detection to selected languages, English and Hindi selected

6. Meeting Notes Workflow

Go to Workflows. Set the default LLM provider to Groq and model to llama-3.3-70b-versatile. Create or edit a workflow named Meeting Notes.

Workflow fields

FieldValue
NameMeeting Notes
TemplateMeeting Notes
Fine-tuning / promptYou are a technical scribe. Receive Hinglish audio and output: 1. Original Transcript (Hinglish), 2. English Summary, 3. Action Items in English. Use Markdown.
Spoken LanguageRestrict detection to selected languages: English and Hindi
LLM ProviderUse workflow default, or explicitly Groq
TriggerHotkey is fine. Hammerspoon starts the workflow through the API, so the hotkey is mostly a fallback.
Output actionExecute action plugin: Obsidian

Verify workflow storage

sqlite3 -json "$HOME/Library/Application Support/TypeWhisper/workflows.store" \
  "select Z_PK,ZNAME,ZISENABLED,ZBEHAVIORDATA,ZOUTPUTDATA,ZTRIGGERDATA from ZWORKFLOW where ZNAME='Meeting Notes';"

Note the Z_PK value. The current machine uses workflow id 1. On a fresh Mac, update the Hammerspoon config if the ID is different.

7. Native Notes View with FSNotes

FSNotes gives a lightweight native Mac app for browsing generated Markdown notes by date/time.

  1. Open FSNotes once.
  2. Create a TypeWhisper folder/project if needed.
  3. Set TypeWhisper's Obsidian vault path to FSNotes' sandboxed Documents folder.
FSNOTES_ROOT="$HOME/Library/Containers/co.fluder.FSNotes/Data/Documents"
mkdir -p "$FSNOTES_ROOT/TypeWhisper"
defaults write com.typewhisper.mac 'plugin.com.typewhisper.obsidian.vaultPath' -string "$FSNOTES_ROOT"
defaults write com.typewhisper.mac 'plugin.com.typewhisper.obsidian.enabled' -bool true
defaults write com.typewhisper.mac 'plugin.com.typewhisper.obsidian.autoExportEnabled' -bool true
defaults write com.typewhisper.mac 'plugin.com.typewhisper.obsidian.dailyNoteEnabled' -bool false

TypeWhisper exports one .md file per 60-second recording segment. The Hammerspoon config below keeps those segments internal: while a call session is active, it appends every segment into one call-level .markdown file, deletes the visible per-segment exports, and asks Groq once at call end to rewrite the note into Original Transcript, English Summary, and Action Items.

8. Hammerspoon Slack/Teams Automation

Hammerspoon watches for actual Slack huddle or Teams call UI. It starts the TypeWhisper Meeting Notes workflow only after several positive checks, stops after the call UI disappears, and rotates long recordings every 60 seconds to avoid oversized Groq transcription requests. Segment files are merged into one call session note, then Groq generates the final Markdown summary/action-item structure once the call has ended.

Install and enable Hammerspoon CLI

brew install --cask hammerspoon
open -a Hammerspoon
/Applications/Hammerspoon.app/Contents/Frameworks/hs/hs -c 'hs.ipc.cliInstall("/opt/homebrew")'
/opt/homebrew/bin/hs -c 'hs.autoLaunch(true)'

Create ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua

Set TYPEWHISPER_MEETING_WORKFLOW_ID to the Z_PK from the workflow query. If this is the first workflow on the machine, it is usually 1. The Groq API key is not written into this file; Hammerspoon reads the same TypeWhisper Groq key from macOS Keychain service com.typewhisper.mac.apikey.com.typewhisper.groq.api-key.

-- Auto-start the TypeWhisper "Meeting Notes" workflow when a real Slack or
-- Microsoft Teams call UI is visible.

hs.ipc.cliInstall("/opt/homebrew")

local CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 2
local START_AFTER_MATCHES = 3
local STOP_AFTER_MISSES = 8
local MAX_RECORDING_SECONDS = 60

local TYPEWHISPER_BUNDLE_ID = "com.typewhisper.mac"
local TYPEWHISPER_API_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8978"
local TYPEWHISPER_MEETING_WORKFLOW_ID = "1"
local HOME = os.getenv("HOME")
local TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER = HOME .. "/Library/Containers/co.fluder.FSNotes/Data/Documents/TypeWhisper"
local GROQ_API_KEY_SERVICE = "com.typewhisper.mac.apikey.com.typewhisper.groq.api-key"
local GROQ_LLM_MODEL = "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"

local watchedApps = {
  {
    name = "Slack",
    bundleID = "com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap",
    titleAny = { "huddle:" },
    requiredAny = { "huddle", "call" },
    callTerms = {
      "leave huddle",
      "leave call",
      "mute microphone",
      "unmute microphone",
      "share screen",
      "camera",
      "turn on camera",
      "turn off camera",
    },
  },
  {
    name = "Microsoft Teams",
    bundleID = "com.microsoft.teams2",
    titleAny = { "meeting", "call" },
    titleAll = { "calendar |", " | microsoft teams" },
    requiredAny = { "meeting", "call" },
    callTerms = {
      "leave",
      "mute",
      "unmute",
      "camera",
      "share",
      "participants",
      "people",
      "raise hand",
    },
  },
}

local mirrorTypeWhisperMarkdown

local state = {
  active = false,
  matchedChecks = 0,
  missedChecks = 0,
  lastReason = "none",
  recordingStartedAt = nil,
  rotating = false,
  callSession = nil,
}

local function lower(value)
  if value == nil then
    return ""
  end
  return string.lower(tostring(value))
end

local function containsAny(text, terms)
  for _, term in ipairs(terms) do
    if string.find(text, term, 1, true) then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

local function containsAll(text, terms)
  for _, term in ipairs(terms or {}) do
    if not string.find(text, term, 1, true) then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

local function countTerms(text, terms)
  local count = 0
  for _, term in ipairs(terms) do
    if string.find(text, term, 1, true) then
      count = count + 1
    end
  end
  return count
end

local function shellQuote(value)
  return "'" .. tostring(value):gsub("'", "'\\''") .. "'"
end

local function basename(path)
  return tostring(path):match("([^/]+)$") or tostring(path)
end

local function removeExtension(name)
  return tostring(name):gsub("%.md$", ""):gsub("%.markdown$", "")
end

local function readFile(path)
  local file = io.open(path, "r")
  if not file then
    return nil
  end
  local content = file:read("*a")
  file:close()
  return content
end

local function writeFile(path, content)
  local file = io.open(path, "w")
  if not file then
    return false
  end
  file:write(content)
  file:close()
  return true
end

local function appendFile(path, content)
  local file = io.open(path, "a")
  if not file then
    return false
  end
  file:write(content)
  file:close()
  return true
end

local function stripTypeWhisperMarkdown(content)
  local lines = {}
  local inFrontmatter = false
  local frontmatterChecked = false
  local skippedTitle = false

  for line in tostring(content):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n?") do
    if line == "" and #lines > 0 and lines[#lines] == "__END__" then
      break
    end

    if not frontmatterChecked then
      frontmatterChecked = true
      if line == "---" then
        inFrontmatter = true
        goto continue
      end
    elseif inFrontmatter then
      if line == "---" then
        inFrontmatter = false
      end
      goto continue
    end

    if not skippedTitle and string.find(line, "^#%s+") then
      skippedTitle = true
      goto continue
    end

    table.insert(lines, line)
    ::continue::
  end

  local text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
  text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  return text
end

local function appNameFromSegmentName(name)
  local title = removeExtension(name)
  local app = title:gsub("^%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d %d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d%s+", "")
  return app
end

local function isCallSegmentFile(path)
  local appName = appNameFromSegmentName(basename(path))
  return appName == "Slack" or appName == "Microsoft Teams"
end

local function startCallSession(reason)
  if state.callSession then
    return
  end

  local appName = string.find(reason, "Slack", 1, true) and "Slack" or "Microsoft Teams"
  local startedAt = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S")
  local title = startedAt .. " " .. appName .. " Call"
  local path = TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER .. "/" .. title .. ".markdown"
  state.callSession = {
    appName = appName,
    title = title,
    path = path,
    segments = 0,
    closing = false,
    finalized = false,
  }

  writeFile(path, "# " .. title .. "\n\n## Original Transcript (Hinglish)\n")
end

local function appendSegmentToCallSession(path)
  if not state.callSession or state.callSession.finalized then
    return false
  end

  local content = readFile(path)
  if not content then
    return false
  end

  local transcript = stripTypeWhisperMarkdown(content)
  if transcript == "" then
    os.remove(path)
    return true
  end

  state.callSession.segments = state.callSession.segments + 1
  local segmentTime = removeExtension(basename(path)):match("^(%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d %d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d)") or os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H-%M-%S")
  appendFile(
    state.callSession.path,
    string.format("\n\n### Segment %d - %s\n\n%s\n", state.callSession.segments, segmentTime, transcript)
  )
  os.remove(path)
  return true
end

local function groqApiKey()
  local command = "/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -w -s " .. shellQuote(GROQ_API_KEY_SERVICE)
  local output, status = hs.execute(command)
  if not status then
    return nil
  end
  return tostring(output):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

local function requestGroqMeetingSummary(session)
  local apiKey = groqApiKey()
  local content = readFile(session.path)
  if not apiKey or apiKey == "" or not content then
    appendFile(session.path, "\n\n## Summary generation error\n\nGroq API key or transcript was not available.\n")
    return
  end

  local transcript = content:gsub("^#.-\n", ""):gsub("^%s+", "")
  local payload = hs.json.encode({
    model = GROQ_LLM_MODEL,
    temperature = 0.2,
    messages = {
      {
        role = "system",
        content = "You are a technical scribe. Receive Hinglish audio transcript segments and output exactly these Markdown sections: 1. Original Transcript (Hinglish), 2. English Summary, 3. Action Items in English. Preserve important technical details. Do not mention segment boundaries unless needed.",
      },
      {
        role = "user",
        content = transcript,
      },
    },
  })

  hs.http.asyncPost(
    "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions",
    payload,
    {
      ["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. apiKey,
      ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
    },
    function(status, body)
      if status ~= 200 then
        appendFile(session.path, "\n\n## Summary generation error\n\nGroq returned HTTP " .. tostring(status) .. ".\n")
        return
      end

      local ok, decoded = pcall(hs.json.decode, body)
      local summary = ok
          and decoded
          and decoded.choices
          and decoded.choices[1]
          and decoded.choices[1].message
          and decoded.choices[1].message.content

      if not summary or summary == "" then
        appendFile(session.path, "\n\n## Summary generation error\n\nGroq returned an empty response.\n")
        return
      end

      writeFile(session.path, "# " .. session.title .. "\n\n" .. summary:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") .. "\n")
    end
  )
end

local function collectAXText(element, depth, seen, out)
  if not element or depth > 5 or #out > 350 then
    return
  end

  local id = tostring(element)
  if seen[id] then
    return
  end
  seen[id] = true

  for _, attr in ipairs({ "AXTitle", "AXDescription", "AXHelp", "AXValue", "AXRole", "AXSubrole" }) do
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
      return element:attributeValue(attr)
    end)
    if ok and value then
      table.insert(out, lower(value))
    end
  end

  local ok, children = pcall(function()
    return element:attributeValue("AXChildren")
  end)
  if ok and children then
    for _, child in ipairs(children) do
      collectAXText(child, depth + 1, seen, out)
    end
  end
end

local function appWindowText(app)
  local chunks = {}

  for _, win in ipairs(app:allWindows() or {}) do
    if win:isVisible() then
      table.insert(chunks, lower(win:title()))
    end
  end

  local axApp = hs.axuielement.applicationElement(app)
  if axApp then
    local ok, windows = pcall(function()
      return axApp:attributeValue("AXWindows")
    end)
    if ok and windows then
      for _, axWindow in ipairs(windows) do
        collectAXText(axWindow, 0, {}, chunks)
      end
    end
  end

  return table.concat(chunks, "\n")
end

local function detectedCall()
  for _, rule in ipairs(watchedApps) do
    local app = hs.application.get(rule.bundleID)
    if app then
      local visibleTitles = {}
      for _, win in ipairs(app:allWindows() or {}) do
        if win:isVisible() then
          local title = lower(win:title())
          table.insert(visibleTitles, title)
          if containsAny(title, rule.titleAny or {}) then
            return true, string.format("%s call window detected: %s", rule.name, win:title())
          end
        end
      end
      local visibleTitleText = table.concat(visibleTitles, "\n")
      if #visibleTitles >= 2 and containsAll(visibleTitleText, rule.titleAll) then
        return true, string.format("%s call window pair detected", rule.name)
      end

      local text = appWindowText(app)
      local hasContext = containsAny(text, rule.requiredAny)
      local matches = countTerms(text, rule.callTerms)

      if hasContext and matches >= 2 then
        return true, string.format("%s call UI detected (%d controls)", rule.name, matches)
      end
    end
  end

  return false, "no Slack/Teams call UI"
end

local function callTypeWhisperAPI(path)
  local body = "{}"
  if path == "/v1/dictation/start" then
    body = string.format("{\"workflow_id\":\"%s\"}", TYPEWHISPER_MEETING_WORKFLOW_ID)
  end
  local command = string.format(
    "/usr/bin/curl -sS -X POST %s%s -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '%s'",
    TYPEWHISPER_API_BASE,
    path,
    body
  )
  local output, status = hs.execute(command)
  return status, output
end

local function typeWhisperIsRecording()
  local command = string.format("/usr/bin/curl -sS %s/v1/dictation/status", TYPEWHISPER_API_BASE)
  local output, status = hs.execute(command)
  return status and string.find(output or "", '"is_recording":true', 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function fireTypeWhisper(path, reason)
  if not hs.application.get(TYPEWHISPER_BUNDLE_ID) then
    hs.execute("/usr/bin/open -gj -b " .. TYPEWHISPER_BUNDLE_ID)
    hs.timer.usleep(1500000)
  end

  hs.timer.doAfter(0.2, function()
    local ok, output = callTypeWhisperAPI(path)
    hs.notify.new({
      title = "TypeWhisper Meeting Notes",
      informativeText = reason .. (ok and "" or (" (" .. tostring(output) .. ")")),
    }):send()
  end)
end

local function tick()
  local inCall, reason = detectedCall()
  state.lastReason = reason

  if inCall then
    state.matchedChecks = state.matchedChecks + 1
    state.missedChecks = 0
  else
    state.missedChecks = state.missedChecks + 1
    state.matchedChecks = 0
  end

  if not state.active and state.matchedChecks >= START_AFTER_MATCHES then
    state.active = true
    state.recordingStartedAt = hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch()
    startCallSession(reason)
    if typeWhisperIsRecording() then
      hs.notify.new({
        title = "TypeWhisper Meeting Notes",
        informativeText = "Recording already active: " .. reason,
      }):send()
    else
      fireTypeWhisper("/v1/dictation/start", "Starting recording: " .. reason)
    end
  elseif state.active and state.missedChecks >= STOP_AFTER_MISSES then
    state.active = false
    state.recordingStartedAt = nil
    state.rotating = false
    local sessionToFinalize = state.callSession
    if sessionToFinalize then
      sessionToFinalize.closing = true
    end
    fireTypeWhisper("/v1/dictation/stop", "Stopping recording: call controls disappeared")
    hs.timer.doAfter(20, function()
      mirrorTypeWhisperMarkdown()
      if sessionToFinalize and not sessionToFinalize.finalized then
        sessionToFinalize.finalized = true
        requestGroqMeetingSummary(sessionToFinalize)
      end
      if state.callSession == sessionToFinalize then
        state.callSession = nil
      end
    end)
  elseif state.active
      and inCall
      and not state.rotating
      and state.recordingStartedAt
      and (hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch() - state.recordingStartedAt) >= MAX_RECORDING_SECONDS then
    state.rotating = true
    fireTypeWhisper("/v1/dictation/stop", "Saving meeting-notes segment")
    hs.timer.doAfter(3, function()
      local stillInCall, stillReason = detectedCall()
      if state.active and stillInCall then
        state.recordingStartedAt = hs.timer.secondsSinceEpoch()
        fireTypeWhisper("/v1/dictation/start", "Starting next segment: " .. stillReason)
      else
        state.active = false
        state.recordingStartedAt = nil
      end
      state.rotating = false
    end)
  end
end

if _G.typewhisperCallWatcherTimer then
  _G.typewhisperCallWatcherTimer:stop()
end

_G.typewhisperCallWatcherTimer = hs.timer.doEvery(CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS, tick)
_G.typewhisperCallWatcherTimer:start()

_G.typewhisperCallWatcherStatus = function()
  local inCall, reason = detectedCall()
  return {
    active = state.active,
    callSession = state.callSession and {
      appName = state.callSession.appName,
      closing = state.callSession.closing,
      finalized = state.callSession.finalized,
      path = state.callSession.path,
      segments = state.callSession.segments,
      title = state.callSession.title,
    } or nil,
    matchedChecks = state.matchedChecks,
    missedChecks = state.missedChecks,
    recordingStartedAt = state.recordingStartedAt,
    rotating = state.rotating,
    currentlyDetected = inCall,
    reason = reason,
    accessibility = hs.accessibilityState(),
  }
end

hs.hotkey.bind({ "cmd", "alt", "ctrl" }, "T", function()
  local inCall, reason = detectedCall()
  hs.alert.show((inCall and "Call detected: " or "No call: ") .. reason)
end)

hs.hotkey.bind({ "cmd", "alt", "ctrl" }, "R", function()
  state.active = false
  state.matchedChecks = 0
  state.missedChecks = 0
  hs.alert.show("TypeWhisper call watcher reset")
end)

function mirrorTypeWhisperMarkdown()
  hs.execute("/bin/mkdir -p " .. shellQuote(TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER))

  for file in hs.fs.dir(TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER) do
    if file ~= "." and file ~= ".." and string.find(file, "%.md$") then
      local source = TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER .. "/" .. file

      if not appendSegmentToCallSession(source) then
        local title = removeExtension(file)
        local target = TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER .. "/" .. title .. ".markdown"
        local sourceAttrs = hs.fs.attributes(source)
        local targetAttrs = hs.fs.attributes(target)

        if not targetAttrs or (sourceAttrs and targetAttrs and sourceAttrs.modification > targetAttrs.modification) then
          local content = stripTypeWhisperMarkdown(readFile(source) or "")
          writeFile(target, "# " .. title .. "\n\n" .. content .. "\n")
          if sourceAttrs and sourceAttrs.modification then
            hs.execute("/usr/bin/touch -r " .. shellQuote(source) .. " " .. shellQuote(target))
          end
        end
        os.remove(source)
      end
    end
  end
end

mirrorTypeWhisperMarkdown()

if _G.typewhisperFSNotesWatcher then
  _G.typewhisperFSNotesWatcher:stop()
end

_G.typewhisperFSNotesWatcher = hs.pathwatcher.new(TYPEWHISPER_FSNOTES_FOLDER, function()
  hs.timer.doAfter(1, mirrorTypeWhisperMarkdown)
end)
_G.typewhisperFSNotesWatcher:start()

hs.alert.show("TypeWhisper call watcher loaded")

Reload and verify

/opt/homebrew/bin/hs -c 'hs.reload()'
/opt/homebrew/bin/hs -c 'return hs.inspect(typewhisperCallWatcherStatus())'

Expected output when no call is active:

{
  accessibility = true,
  active = false,
  currentlyDetected = false,
  reason = "no Slack/Teams call UI",
  rotating = false
}

During an active call, the same status includes a callSession object with the call note path, segment count, and finalization state.

9. End-to-End Verification

Verify TypeWhisper before joining a call

typewhisper status
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8978/v1/dictation/status
/opt/homebrew/bin/hs -c 'return hs.inspect(typewhisperCallWatcherStatus())'

Expected: TypeWhisper ready, is_recording:false, watcher has accessibility = true.

Verify system audio permission

  1. Open TypeWhisper > Recorder.
  2. Ensure Microphone and System Audio are on.
  3. Click Start Recording.
  4. Expected: recording starts and shows both Microphone and System Audio meters. If a red permission error appears, revisit macOS permissions.
  5. Stop the recording after a few seconds.

Verify Slack/Teams auto-start

  1. Start a real Slack huddle or Teams call window.
  2. Wait about 6 seconds. Hammerspoon requires 3 consecutive positive checks.
  3. Run:
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8978/v1/dictation/status
/opt/homebrew/bin/hs -c 'return hs.inspect(typewhisperCallWatcherStatus())'

Expected during a call: is_recording:true, active = true, a reason mentioning Slack or Teams call UI, and a callSession object whose segments count increases as 60-second chunks are saved.

Verify notes after call end

After the call UI disappears, Hammerspoon waits about 16 seconds, stops recording, waits for the final TypeWhisper export, merges all call segments into one FSNotes note, and then calls Groq for final transcript/summary/action-item formatting.

find "$HOME/Library/Containers/co.fluder.FSNotes/Data/Documents/TypeWhisper" \
  -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.markdown' -o -name '*.md' \) -print0 |
  xargs -0 ls -lt | sed -n '1,10p'

Open FSNotes and select the TypeWhisper folder. Expected result: one new call-level note, not one note per 60-second segment. The note should contain Original Transcript, English Summary, and Action Items headings after Groq finalization.

10. Troubleshooting

ProblemLikely causeFix
Red error: Screen recording permission is required for system audio capture. TypeWhisper is missing System Audio Recording permission or has not restarted after permission grant. Add TypeWhisper under Screen & System Audio Recording and System Audio Recording Only. Choose Quit & Reopen.
Hammerspoon never detects Slack/Teams calls. Accessibility permission missing, Hammerspoon not running, wrong Teams bundle id, or no actual call window. Grant Accessibility, reload Hammerspoon, and run typewhisperCallWatcherStatus(). Detection intentionally ignores a Slack invite screen where nobody has joined.
TypeWhisper starts but no note appears. Workflow output action got reset, Groq transcription failed, the final Groq summary call failed, or the call was too short/quiet. Check workflow ZOUTPUTDATA, TypeWhisper history, Hammerspoon status, and TypeWhisper error log. The Hammerspoon config rotates recordings every 60 seconds to reduce Groq transcription message-size failures.
FSNotes shows multiple notes for one call. Old Hammerspoon mirror logic is installed, Hammerspoon was not reloaded, or TypeWhisper exported segments when no call session was active. Replace ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua with this guide's version, reload Hammerspoon, and verify callSession appears during calls. Existing segment notes can be merged manually and moved to a hidden backup folder.
System volume drops during recording. Audio Ducking enabled. Recording settings > Reduce system volume during recording: off. Verify with defaults read com.typewhisper.mac audioDuckingEnabled.
FSNotes does not show exported files. Wrong folder, FSNotes has not refreshed, or Hammerspoon did not merge/finalize the call session. Confirm the Obsidian vault path, run typewhisperCallWatcherStatus(), check the call note path under callSession, and reopen FSNotes if needed.

Useful inspection commands

defaults read com.typewhisper.mac | egrep 'selectedEngine|selectedLanguage|preserveClipboard|appFormattingEnabled|audioDuckingEnabled|recorderSystemAudioEnabled|apiServerEnabled|plugin.com.typewhisper.groq|plugin.com.typewhisper.obsidian|workflowDefaultLLM'

sqlite3 -header -column "$HOME/Library/Application Support/TypeWhisper/history.store" \
  "select datetime(ZTIMESTAMP + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') as local_time, ZAPPNAME, ZENGINEUSED, ZMODELUSED, ZWORDSCOUNT, substr(ZFINALTEXT,1,500) as final_text from ZTRANSCRIPTIONRECORD order by ZTIMESTAMP desc limit 5;"

sed -n '1,200p' "$HOME/Library/Application Support/TypeWhisper/error-log.json"
Security note: never store the Groq API key in this HTML file, shell history, or git. Paste it into the TypeWhisper Groq integration UI so it is stored in the macOS Keychain. The Hammerspoon config only stores the Keychain service name and reads the key locally at final-summary time.
